description.value: Big Star Sandwich Company is a Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013, anchored around hearty sandwiches built on fresh-baked rustic Filone bread with house-roasted meats including 13-hour slow-roasted beef and hand-pulled turkey breast. The Broadway location at 802 W Broadway is one of six across the region. Touring cyclists will find substantial, made-from-scratch sandwiches with confirmed vegetarian and vegan options, plus catering available for groups.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 58m; rack at 98m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Broadway location at 802 W Broadway with phone (236) 757-5477, directly matching OSM tags. OSM diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are corroborated by the website's menu framing around fresh vegetables and customizable builds. No bike-specific amenities, washroom details, or water refill information appear anywhere in the website content.
